epithet identifying the goddess as mother

items.question: What identity and divine honors are attributed to the goddess who destroys Niśumbha?
premises: The goddess is identified as the destroyer of Niśumbha and others.
The goddess is worshipped by Hari and Śaṅkara.
items.inference: The destroyer of Niśumbha is the mother goddess honored by Hari and Śaṅkara.
items.plain_english: She is the destroyer of Niśumbha and others, the Mother, worshipped by Hari and Śaṅkara.
